# Vendored cavacore

`cavacore.c` and `cavacore.h` are copied **unmodified** from cava 1.0.0
(<https://github.com/karlstav/cava>, tag `1.0.0`, the same version as the `/usr/bin/cava`
the legacy shell runs). MIT licensed; see `LICENSE` (cava's project license) and the
notice at the top of `cavacore.h`. Built by `build.rs` with the `cc` crate and linked
against the system `libfftw3`.

SHA-256 (tag 1.0.0 tarball contents):
- cavacore.c `416700906719a8e08cd8437e3fc64a90e5ea19f98dfff69c873ae0d40e821044`
- cavacore.h `ef427db332cab781e563be2336f4b29a9467b2872efb1b310f2d8d843dcea834`
